parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Addition polymers can be classified into two types.

- homopolymer - a polymer made up of the same monomer unit
- copolymer - a polymer made up of two or more different monomer units

The reaction of propene, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}=\text{CH}_2$, with phenylethene, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}=\text{CH}_2$, gives a copolymer.

Draw a length of the chain of this copolymer that contains one molecule of **each** monomer.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
Polyalkenes biodegrade very slowly.

Explain why by referring to the structures of the polymers.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
Some polymers will degrade in the environment.

Describe **two** processes by which this occurs.
